messages:
maria: Quick async check on Optimize toolkit delivery — milestones + owners + blockers for quant/batching/caching. Posting a short status and asks.

maria: TL;DR — need final quant recs for v0.9 by EOD Wed, batching config PR reviewed + infra tests, and regression alert triage for KV-cache/reranker. Please ping owners and call out blockers.

chris: Working on perf matrix for q8_0 (8-bit) on A100. Early numbers: latency ~+12% p50, cost ~-40% tokens. I'll drop a spreadsheet in ~2h with across-seq breakdowns.

alex: I can own the batching config PR. PR #512 is up for review, added README on config knobs. Pinging @devon for infra validation (CI/scale tests).

devon: Running scale tests now. Seeing a flaky failure under parallelism: `ERROR kvcache: eviction under high parallelism` — reproducer in stress suite. Bisecting to isolate.

hana: Noted. Also triaging two reranker regressions for long prompts from yesterday (precision drop ~3%). Investigating dataset skew; will post repro.

build-bot: CI: pr-512 build -> passed (unit + lint), integration tests queued.

chris: Maria — quick question: for fallback policy, do we allow falling back to lower-precision variant automatically, or must routes opt-in? Need to know for measurable perf comparisons.

maria: Fallback policy: auto-fallback allowed only for latency-sensitive routes. Document requirement: route must set `allow_quant_fallback=true`. Default is opt-out. Add a flag in rollout config.

alex: Acknowledged. I'll add the flag to the batching config and update PR description. Also added benchmarking script in the branch — @chris can you review perf harness snippet?

chris: Will review. Also leaving notes in the sheet about expected tradeoffs at seq lengths 256/512/1024.

devon: Hotfix pushed for kvcache eviction: commit abc123. Rolling to staging; running `pytest -k kv_eviction --timeout=300`. If green will promote to canary.

hana: Deployed reranker fix to staging; suppressed two alerts. Still validating on long-tail QA set.

maria: Owners summary: quant recs -> chris; batching config + flag -> alex; cache regressions -> devon & hana. Milestones: v0.9 quant recs by Wed EOD; batching PR merged by Fri COB; kv-cache regression triage done by Tue morning. Call out if any of these are infeasible.

alex: Will aim for Fri merge. CI + infra tests are the main blockers — pinging @devon for ETA on scale tests.

devon: ETA ~4h for full scale run; if failures persist might need a short fix window.

chris: Posted sheet: https://internal.redwood/sheets/quant-v0.9 (internal). Bench commands in sheet.

maria: Small PR description ask: include a brief perf summary and exact bench commands to reproduce (example: `--seq 1024 --batch 8 --kv-cache`). Saves time for reviewers.

devon: Test command used for repro: ```pytest tests/integration/test_inference.py::test_kv_eviction -k heavy --timeout=300``` — leaving logs in /tmp/kv-evict.log.

build-bot: Regression alert: reranker-2 -> suppressed after hana/staging deploy.

maria: Great. I'll collate into a short cross-team status doc and ping Eng Leadership by EOD if no new blockers. Please drop any last-minute updates here. :thumbsup:

alex: Quick heads-up — I left a code comment in PR about default batch size; if we change default we should update docs + console defaults.

chris: Seen, will comment on tradeoffs.

devon: Staging run green, promoting to canary now.

hana: Triage meeting scheduled 10:00 AM PT tomorrow, invite sent to relevant owners.

maria: Thanks all — will follow up with a short note and action items.

alex: Seen and 👍
